values.note: Off season (mid September to May 15) by e-mail or message and the park calls back; from May 15 by the office phone. Cancellations 14+ days out are refunded in full, under 14 days 50%, under 7 days nothing; no refunds on long-weekend bookings.

NO REFUNDS FOR LONG WEEKEND BOOKINGS'), read 2026-11-18

values.note: Non-serviced C$22 a night, 30-amp full service C$35, 50-amp full service C$40; weekly and monthly rates also posted. A seasonal park pass is sold instead of the daily entry.

fees.source: https://saskregionalparks.ca/park/big-river/ ('(Taxes included in prices ...)'; '30 Amp Full Service Daily $35.00'; '50 Amp Full Service Daily $40.00'; 'Non-Serviced – Cowan Lake and Community Centre Campgrounds Daily $22.00'; 'Park Entry: $10.00 per day or Seasonal Park Pass'), read 2026-11-18

note: Treed in-town campground of Big River Regional Park on the north side of town, beside ball diamonds and horseshoe pits and across the street from a 9-hole golf course; restaurants and stores are within five blocks.  Cowan Lake's town dock and free boat launch are about 1 km away.  Campers under 18 must be with an adult. --Claude
summary: Keep (regional park campground in town). 49 sites (37 nightly + 12 seasonal), 30/50 A full service, C$22-40 taxes in, park entry C$10/day, phone/e-mail booking, season mid May to fall. Not waterfront kept (Cowan Lake ~900 m). Pin fine. Phone empty -> 306-469-2232. Lead: the park's second campground, Cowan Lake Campground, is not in the DB.
flags: NIGHTLY SHARE: 37 of 49 sites nightly (76%); the 12 seasonal sites have a waiting list. Not mostly seasonal.
GOOGLE: 4.3 (46 reviews), for 'Big River Regional Park' at 53.83787,-107.02542 (this campground).
WATERFRONT: 'not waterfront' kept - loops sit among ball diamonds and the arena on the north edge of town; Cowan Lake's shore is ~900 m SW (Esri z15/z17).
PIN: stored 53.83800,-107.02480 is inside the campground loop (Esri z17); keep.

ATV: 'ATV's – can be driven out of the park in designated sites ... No ATV's are to be driven in or out of Cowan Lake Campground'; 'Both campgrounds offer easy access to numerous quadding trails in the area.' A general town campground with ATV access, not a staging camp - stays; flag only.
SITES: stored count 37 excluded the 12 seasonal sites; 49 per the convention. No max rig length posted anywhere read; the park says 'large sites'.

WEBSITE: keep https://saskregionalparks.ca/park/big-river/ (the park's only page with rates; the park links bigriver.ca as its website). The bigriver.ca tourism page only mentions the park in one paragraph; keep as second link or drop.

INCLUSION_EVIDENCE: replace with 'saskregionalparks.ca Big River page: Community Centre Campground has 2 x 50-amp + 31 x 30-amp full-service, 4 non-serviced and 12 seasonal sites; nightly rates C$22-40; coin showers, laundry -> real drive-in RV campground (2026-11-18)'.

LEAD: Cowan Lake Campground (Big River Regional Park's other campground, 'located at the end of Main Street in Big River', lakeside: '(14) 30 amp sites and (2) 50 amp electrical sites as well as non-serviced sites', 'picturesque views of the lake', full services, private dock). Not in campgrounds.json (no 'Cowan Lake' entry in SK). Approx. on the east shore of Cowan Lake at the foot of Main Street, about 53.828,-107.035 (from Esri z15, unvetted).
